idea-plugin.name: SpeakIDE
idea-plugin.description:
SpeakIDE — Voice dictation straight into your IDE!

Press a shortcut, speak, and your words appear wherever your cursor is: the code editor, AI Chat, Junie, or a commit message.

  • Two STT backends: Choose between OpenAI Whisper (Cloud, requires API key) and Vosk (Offline, local processing).
  • Universal input: Works in any text field within IntelliJ IDEA.
  • Auto-stop on silence: Automatically stops recording after a configurable pause.
  • Microphone button: Integrates directly into the AI Assistant chat toolbar.

A must-have for developers looking to boost their productivity with voice commands.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
0.1.3

  • Performance: STT providers are now cached in RecordingService — no re-initialization overhead between recordings.

0.1.2

  • New STT backend: Whisper Local (offline, ggml models) — no internet or API key required.
  • Added hallucination filter for local Whisper output.
  • Refactored offline providers into a shared OfflineSttProvider base — cleaner Vosk and Whisper implementations.
  • Improved audio resampling logic.

0.1.1

  • Internal refactoring: cleaner architecture, better stability.
  • Fixed Ktor classloader conflict with IntelliJ Platform.

0.1.0

  • Initial release of SpeakIDE!
  • Added OpenAI Whisper (Cloud) and Vosk (Offline) support.
  • Added auto-stop on silence detection.
  • Added AI Assistant integration toolbar icon.

action.description: Start or stop voice recording; transcribed text is inserted at the cursor
